_comment: Real subject lines sent from the krewe address, recovered from live Gmail by the
97b8c18). The archive cannot supply these: messages.jsonl has no subject field and
the scraper built thread titles from body first lines, so every subject statistic
derivable from the vault measures the scrape (wavebucks#30).
ERA CAVEAT: all of these are the SUCCESSOR era. Abe wrote the operator address
until he retired around 2025 and readInbox for before:2025/01/01 on the Office
mailbox returns ZERO mail, so Abe-era subjects still do not exist in any store.
Anything derived here describes current practice, not the voice the rest of the
aedile:true marks subjects this project generated. They are excluded from every
rate: training a subject generator on its own output is a feedback loop.
FOUR are aedile's, not two. The Half Moon pair was marked on 2026-09-26 after
the list-scrape session built a Log-based detector. This session had ALREADY READ
the Log rows -- five recap_draft_posted rows for those two subjects at
2026-09-14T02:29-02:35Z -- reported them, and then spent an hour citing Half Moon
as the human exemplar of the genre, once in writing as hand-written. Nothing in
the message says aedile wrote it; only the Log does, and the Log had been read.
